old_caption: The video begins with a close-up view of a wooden floor where various colorful blocks are scattered. A hand appears from the left side of the frame, pointing towards the blocks. The hand then moves away, and the scene transitions to show a series of dominoes arranged in a curved pattern on the same wooden surface. The dominoes are in vibrant colors—red, yellow, green, and white—and they are set up in a way that suggests an impending chain reaction. As the video progresses, the dominoes begin to fall one after another in a cascading effect, creating a visually satisfying sequence. The camera remains stationary throughout, focusing on the dominoes as they topple over, emphasizing the dynamic movement and the colorful arrangement against the warm-toned wooden background.

caption: The first view shows a wooden plank floor with scattered pieces: a white T-shaped block, a flat white rectangle, a green GO sign with a red block, a blue block, and a long white domino row along the upper right. A green domino slides toward the top-right corner while the other objects stay put. A hard cut then replaces the layout with an S-shaped chain of standing red, yellow and green dominoes, each end joined to a short white row. In this second view the left white row stands upright before tilting and falling rightward in a smooth wave. The toppled white pieces knock the green domino at the junction, and the collapse spreads into the colored chain, toppling the leftmost dominoes up the curve. The rest of the loop and the right white row stay standing as the clip ends mid-propagation.
